text:
elena_cs: Quick preflight for Lumina cutover tomorrow 10:00 PT. Need confirmations on: (1) egress for log-forwarder, (2) cross-account KMS access, (3) S3 mirror policy, (4) audit log retention+WORM, and (5) any renewal signals (they're currently month-to-month). Keeping this short before the runbook call.

derek_net: I reviewed their VPC. Log-forwarder lives in private subnet -> NAT gw. Two asks: remove 0.0.0.0/0 in the long run, and add explicit VPCE + SG egress to three targets.

derek_net: SG egress example:
```
Type: egress
Proto: TCP
Port: 443
Cidr/Target:
  - vpce-0a1b2c3d (s3 endpoint)
  - 203.0.113.45/32 (splunk.ingest.lumina.com)
  - telemetry-collector.redwood.internal:443
```

derek_net: Also suggest route table fix to point s3 prefix -> vpce instead of NAT. Low risk for pre-prod but recommend to change during cutover window.

sam_platform: I'll push a tiny Terraform patch they can apply in minutes. Will include route_table_ids example and a policy limiting PutObject to the telemetry prefix.

sam_platform: Terraform snippet for VPCE and route table:
```hcl
resource "aws_vpc_endpoint" "s3_telemetry" {
  vpc_id       = var.vpc_id
  service_name = "com.amazonaws.${var.region}.s3"
  vpc_endpoint_type = "Gateway"
  route_table_ids = var.route_table_ids
  policy = <<POLICY
{
  "Statement": [{"Effect":"Allow","Principal":"*","Action":"s3:PutObject","Resource":"arn:aws:s3:::lumina-telemetry/*"}]
}
POLICY
}
```

raul_kms: For KMS: customer should create a symmetric CMK in their account with a key policy granting a dedicated role in our aggregator account kms:Decrypt, kms:GenerateDataKey. Keep key rotation enabled (annual) by default. If Lumina requests quarterly, note re-encryption work for archived objects.

raul_kms: KMS key policy (trimmed):
```json
{
  "Statement": [
    {"Effect":"Allow","Principal":{"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/redwood-telemetry-decrypt"},"Action":["kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey"],"Resource":"*"}
  ]
}
```

marta_sec: IAM: they need to create an assume-role grant for redwood with a trust policy allowing sts:AssumeRole from our redwood account id. Minimum permissions for the role: s3:GetObject on lumina-telemetry/*, kms:Decrypt on the CMK ARN, and logs:PutLogEvents if using CloudWatch. Add aws:SourceVpc condition to limit abuse.

marta_sec: Example trust policy for their role:
```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [{
    "Effect": "Allow",
    "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:root"},
    "Action": "sts:AssumeRole",
    "Condition": {"StringEquals": {"aws:SourceVpc": "vpc-0abcde"}}
  }]
}
```

louis_eng: On the client side: our private agent expects mTLS to the splunk appliance. Do they accept uploading a cert or do we need to provide a CSR? If they want rotation, advise 90-day certs; we can automate renewals but need their process.

elena_cs: I've asked Lumina to confirm cert flow and whether they require client certs be signed by their internal CA. Also asked about WORM requirement. Their reply: "need tamper-evident retention for 3 years, legal hold TBD".

elena_cs: Renewal risk: Lumina is month-to-month and has usage under threshold. Recommend offering a 6-month reserved pack after stabilization; flag to AE for follow-up in week2. Not urgent for cutover but log as renewal action item.

derek_net: Small ops optimization: Lumina is sampling at 100% for debug traces. Recommend enabling prefix-based sampling and 1:10 sampling for non-critical spans initial 72 hours to control egress and processing costs.

sam_platform: I'll add a config snippet to the runbook to enable sampling and then roll down after day 3.

elena_cs: Action items before tomorrow: (1) Lumina to provide splunk FQDN cert details or CSR instr, (2) Lumina to create CMK and share ARN, (3) Lumina to create role with trust policy and share role ARN, (4) confirm WORM/legal-hold. I'll assemble these in the runbook doc and we'll validate in the 10:00 PT call.

ops-bot: (automated) Runbook reminder: Lumina cutover meeting 10:00 PT tomorrow. Runbook: https://docs.redwood/internal/runbooks/lumina-cutover

elena_cs: Thanks all 44d. If anything lands in this thread Ill update the runbook; otherwise see you at the cutover.
